checks: Template selection and Escape do not mutate the score; focus returns to the trigger.
Single-layer application preserves pitches and the other layer; no-op creates no history; undo restores both original arrays.
All 11 unique templates keep their exact durations; 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8 repeat 4, 3 and 2 times without pitch generation.
6/8 whole-bar dual-layer application creates six eighth rests on each layer and reverses as one operation.
Three numbered events can be retimed while two TAB events block dual-layer application; neither layer changes.
Insufficient, absent, cross-bar and protected ranges block application; incomplete selection expands only after an explicit scope action.
Expired previews require refreshing; failed submission preserves the score and selection and can be retried.
The active TAB layer is the default; empty search has a recovery action; cancel returns focus.
Desktop and review-only 720px/390px layouts render; narrow layouts have no horizontal page overflow.
